source_clause_boundary: Every nonblank physical source line is exactly one full parsed clause; ASCII quoted identifiers and signed decimal rational literals; no unparsed prose permitted. Decimal punctuation is not a boundary.
quantity_semantics: Same exact entity/period/metric binding. Explicit affine equalities only; independent primitive intervals and acyclic expression DAG. USD/thousandUSD/millionUSD normalize toUSD; percent to rationalratio; signed items quantities are integer balances and may be negative. All derived items values must remain integral in every supplied compatible world. Unsupported coupled fact+definition constraints abstain.
set_semantics: In each exact entity/period frame, exactly two distinct named sets are subsets of the single declared common universe. All cardinalities and every2x2cell are nonnegative bounded integers. This subset relation is part of the formal controlled grammar, not an inferred financial relation.
certificate_semantics: E/C use exact affine/cardinality extrema only after full supplied source parse and actual feasible full-source worlds. N requires both claim-true and claim-false concrete worlds satisfying all source constraints, plus selected whole-source catalog coverage. No absent retrieved clause implies insufficient evidence.
scope: New authored controlled financial ENG only; not unrestricted10K parsing, ClaimBenchpilot, benchmark generalization, confirmation, calibration or promotion.
